name: Start mining
description: Your funds are what your cores on this tile hold, starting with your scout's. Build a second Core (Units tab, 2) off the scout's frame so this tile keeps funds when the scout leaves. Pick the Drill (Production tab, 1), place it on copper ore and run Conveyors (Logistics tab, 1) from it into that core. Belts face the way you rotate them (R).

name: Smelt iron
description: Belt iron ore into a Smelter making Iron Plate (Production tab, 3) and its plates on to the core.

name: Lift off your scout
description: Steel needs coal, and your home tile has none. Your scout stands on its frame in the victory circle; its core's stock goes with it and pays for building where it lands, so leave some ore in it (or belt more in). Hover its core with no building picked and press G to lift it off.

name: Claim the coal tile
description: Open the world map (Tab), select a neighbouring tile with coal and press C to send the scout to its victory circle. Press G there to land it. Hold a building in the circle until the timer fills and the tile is yours.

name: Link your tiles
description: On the new tile, mine coal (paid from what the landed scout's core brought) and belt it into an Export Port (Logistics tab, 2) placed in the I/O zone bordering your home tile. On your home tile, put an Import Port (Logistics tab, 3) in the zone bordering the coal tile: ports pair by zone, whichever way they face.

name: Make steel
description: A Steel Mill (Production tab, 4) costs copper plates too: smelt some with a Smelter making Copper Plate (Production tab, 2). Feed the mill iron plates and coal. Thrusters need steel.

name: Build a unit
description: Lay Unit Frame (Units tab, 1), put a Core (2) and Thrusters (3) on it, then hover the core with no building picked and press G. Every unit has exactly one core.
